solutions.check: grid and clues read from the FT's printable PDF, its numbering matching the clue list; every fifteensquared answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Something that prevents quarrel where items are sold

parts.note: a bar is an obstacle that stops something happening
a row is a noisy argument

explanation.surface: A peacekeeping measure at a market, stopping traders from squabbling.
explanation.walkthrough: A barrow is a street trader's handcart, from which goods are sold at a market.
explanation.definitionFit: A costermonger's handcart serves as a mobile stall from which fruit or other goods are sold.

clue.text: Herb vicar's uncovered in church

parts.note: basil is a culinary herb

indicators.note: the covering letters at each end of the word vicar's are stripped away

explanation.surface: A clergyman's herbs are on show inside the church.
explanation.definitionFit: A basilica is a large oblong church, especially one given special privileges by the Pope.

clue.text: After resistance, change census area — that allays doubts

indicators.note: the rest of the wordplay comes after the resistance letter

parts.note: R is the physics symbol for electrical resistance

indicators.note: change tells us to rearrange the letters of census area

explanation.surface: Following opposition, an official alters a census district to calm people's worries.
explanation.definitionFit: Reassurance is comfort that removes someone's fears or doubts.

clue.text: City in Laos, look!

indicators.note: in signals that the answer sits inside the run of words Laos, look

explanation.surface: A tourist in Laos points excitedly at a city.
explanation.definitionFit: Oslo is the capital city of Norway.

clue.text: Taking lead from Sita, Stoic converted — embracing eastern philosophy

indicators.note: converted shows the letters are transformed into a new order
the leading letter is removed from the name Sita

explanation.surface: Sita influences a Stoic philosopher who converts to an oriental faith.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Taking lead from' removes S from SITA to leave ITA; 'converted' shuffles ITA with STOIC.
explanation.definitionFit: Taoism is a Chinese philosophy, so a follower of it is embracing that eastern way of thought.

clue.text: There's assistance here to welcome rerouted flier?

definitions.text: There's assistance here to welcome rerouted flier?

indicators.note: the help word takes in the scrambled flier, as a host takes in a guest

parts.note: aid means help or assistance

indicators.note: rerouted means the letters of flier are sent along a different order

explanation.surface: An airport offers help to a pilot whose route has been diverted.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue does double duty: read straight, it describes a landing ground offering help to a diverted pilot, as well as building the word.
explanation.definitionFit: An airfield is a landing ground, a place where an aircraft diverted from its route can find help.

clue.text: Shattered bike racer swallowing tablet — it relieves tension

indicators.note: the scrambled letters take in the pill, as a mouth swallows one
shattered means the letters of bike racer are broken up and reassembled

parts.note: E is slang for an ecstasy tablet

explanation.surface: An exhausted cyclist takes a pill, which eases the strain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shattered' looks like tiredness but it is the anagram signal; the shuffle of BIKE RACER takes in E.
explanation.definitionFit: An icebreaker is a game or remark that eases awkwardness among people meeting for the first time.

clue.text: Tiger starts with it of course

definitions.text: Tiger starts with it of course

parts.words: Tiger starts with it of course
parts.note: Tiger Woods, the golfer, starts each hole on a golf course from this peg or patch

explanation.definitionFit: A tee is the small peg, or the area, from which a golfer drives off at each hole.

clue.text: Reduction in size permitted in meat

parts.note: a cut is a reduction
let means allowed or permitted

explanation.surface: Smaller portions are now allowed for meat dishes.
explanation.definitionFit: A cutlet is a small piece of meat such as a lamb chop.

clue.text: Mischievous act in Portugal, giving off bad smell

parts.note: P is the international vehicle code for Portugal
rank means foul-smelling

explanation.surface: A naughty stunt in Portugal produces a nasty stink.
explanation.definitionFit: A prank is a practical joke or piece of mischief.

clue.text: Office item even more out-of-date quietly installed

indicators.note: installed means the soft-music letter is put inside the older word

parts.note: staler means older and less fresh
p is the musical abbreviation for piano, quietly

explanation.surface: An even older piece of office equipment is quietly put in place.
explanation.definitionFit: A stapler is a desk device for fastening papers together, a typical piece of office equipment.

clue.text: Agree lecturer's content to choose incumbent?

indicators.note: content means what is contained within the words Agree lecturer's

explanation.surface: A university lecturer agrees with what is being taught before a vote on the post holder.
explanation.definitionFit: To return a sitting office-holder by vote is to vote them in again.

clue.text: Only remaining shoemaker's model

definitions.meaning: the final one left, the only survivor
a cobbler's foot-shaped block used for making shoes

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both the final one left and a cobbler's wooden foot shape.

clue.text: Fez trainee refashioned — it's useful in winter

indicators.note: refashioned means the letters of Fez trainee are remade in a new form

explanation.surface: A trainee's fez hat is remade into something handy for the cold.
explanation.definitionFit: Antifreeze is added to car radiators to stop the coolant freezing in cold weather.

clue.text: Unusually nice article, he might shed light?

indicators.note: unusually tells us the letters of nice article appear in an unusual order

explanation.surface: An uncommonly pleasant piece of writing might explain things.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shed light' sounds like explaining, but the definition means someone who wires up lamps.
explanation.definitionFit: An electrician installs lighting, so he literally makes a place light up.

clue.text: Play has racier tone unfortunately

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things have gone wrong, so the letters of racier tone are jumbled

explanation.surface: A theatre play suffers from an overly risqué tone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Play' looks like a theatre noun, but it means leisure activity.
explanation.definitionFit: Recreation is leisure activity done for enjoyment, which is what play means here.

clue.text: Finally changing sides, US president establishing trade body

indicators.note: the last letter, R for right, swaps to L for left

parts.note: Jimmy Carter was the 39th US president

explanation.surface: A US president who switched party at the end sets up a trade association.
explanation.definitionFit: A cartel is an association of firms that fixes prices or output, a kind of trading body.

clue.text: Worker less productive after cold

indicators.note: after means the less-productive word follows the cold letter

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps
leaner, as in lean years, means less fruitful

explanation.surface: An employee becomes less efficient after catching a chill.
explanation.definitionFit: A cleaner is someone employed to clean houses or offices, a kind of worker.

clue.text: Annoys with criticism, singular, that's avoidable

parts.note: to needle someone is to provoke them with jibes
S is the grammatical abbreviation for singular

explanation.surface: Someone nags with criticism, which could easily have been avoided.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unnecessary could have been avoided altogether, so it is avoidable.

clue.text: Urged to reform internally, gone off alcohol, very hard work!

indicators.note: internally means the reworked letters sit inside the teetotal word

parts.note: dry describes someone who has stopped drinking alcohol

indicators.note: to reform means the letters of Urged are formed anew

explanation.surface: A drinker urged to change their ways quits alcohol, finding it tough going.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gone off alcohol' reads like souring drink, but it describes a person who has turned teetotal.
explanation.definitionFit: Drudgery is dull, laborious and exhausting toil.

clue.text: Like Venus de Milo, with no warlike threat?

definitions.meaning: the famous Greek statue has lost both its arms
carrying no weapons and so posing no danger

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both lacking arms as limbs and carrying no weapons.

clue.text: Landlord's means of communication

definitions.meaning: someone who lets property to tenants
a written message sent by post

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both one who lets out property and a posted written message.

clue.text: French city hotel in area known to clergyman

parts.note: Paris is the capital of France
H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A clergyman knows a hotel in a district of the French capital.
explanation.definitionFit: A parish is the district served by a particular priest or vicar.

clue.text: Most important tree on street

parts.note: a fir is a coniferous tree

explanation.surface: The most significant tree stands on a particular road.
explanation.definitionFit: First can mean foremost or highest in rank, the most important.

clue.text: After drink and kiss, joiner recalling song in Mediterranean port

indicators.note: after places the joiner and song pieces after the drink and kiss

parts.note: ale is beer
X is the symbol for a kiss at the end of a letter
and is a conjunction, a joining word

indicators.note: recalling means calling back, so the song word is read backwards

parts.note: an air is a tune or song

explanation.surface: After a beer and a kiss, a carpenter remembers a tune in a harbour city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'joiner' suggests a carpenter but is the conjunction AND; 'recalling' turns AIR into RIA.
explanation.definitionFit: Alexandria is a major Egyptian port on the Mediterranean coast.

clue.text: Gentle sort

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both benevolent and a class or type of thing.

clue.text: Actors discarded

definitions.meaning: thrown away or shed, as a snake its skin

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a play's company of performers and thrown off.

clue.text: Motivate at home with religious feature

parts.note: in means at home
a spire is the pointed tower on a church

explanation.surface: Something to motivate those who stay at home: a church steeple.
explanation.definitionFit: To inspire someone is to fill them with the urge to act, to motivate them.

clue.text: Unhappy as island regularly ignored

indicators.note: every other letter of the word island is skipped, keeping the rest

explanation.surface: Someone is miserable because an island keeps being overlooked.
explanation.definitionFit: Sad means sorrowful or unhappy, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Lacking time, take land out of production creating leisure area

indicators.note: lacking means the time letter is missing from the farming phrase

parts.note: to set aside is to leave farmland uncultivated

explanation.surface: Short of time, a farmer leaves fields fallow to make a recreation zone.
explanation.walkthrough: Set-aside was an EU scheme paying farmers to leave fields uncultivated.
explanation.definitionFit: The seaside is the coast visited for holidays and leisure.

clue.text: Search for fun the don is misrepresenting? Not entirely

indicators.note: not entirely means only part of the run the don is misrepresenting is used

explanation.surface: A university don misrepresents a quest for pleasure.
explanation.definitionFit: Hedonism is the pursuit of pleasure as the main goal in life.

clue.text: Doctor gin in filthy room? That's mean

indicators.note: in places the doctored drink inside the dirty room

parts.note: a sty is a pigsty, so any filthy room

indicators.note: to doctor is to tamper with, so the letters of gin are altered

explanation.surface: Someone adulterates gin in a squalid room, which is a mean trick.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' looks like a noun but is a verb meaning tamper, signalling an anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: Stingy means mean with money, unwilling to spend or give.
